GitHub branch protection/ruleset remains the live external enforcement layer and must be verified separately.

role_dispositions.destination: .github/workflows/continuity-guard.yml; every push run remains independently executable instead of being cancelled by a later push
tests/architecture_change_guard.py unchanged; it continues validating the exact push range supplied by GitHub

capability_probes.assertion: The full continuity-guard job still runs the existing architecture, continuity, System, provenance, optimizer and XMind guards.

Superseded pull-request continuity runs may still be cancelled to avoid unnecessary duplicate CI.
The previous workflow semantics remain recoverable in Git history and the candidate is isolated from main until promotion.
